text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's annual summer training camp.
From day one, Sakura Chiyono O was fired up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I will definitely become a rival worthy of Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm still no match for her strength right now.
Even if I cannot ignite a fire in her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I just give up thinking it's impossible for me,
everything will end before I can even accomplish anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In other words, "if I don't reach out, I can't even turn on the faucet"!! Trainer, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the summer training camp
with Sakura Chiyono O began!
